text:
Maya S.: Heads-up: CVE-2026-1122 in kube-client v1.4.2 (path traversal) — patch released to 1.4.3. We pushed a 10% canary to svc-inference-canary just now. Need post-patch validation plan: smoke tests, perf regression checks, audit/KMS verification, and quick rollback criteria. :eyes:

AJ: Thanks. What are the exact canary targets and the initial watch window?

Maya S.: Canary group: svc-inference-canary (10% traffic). Initial watch: 30m for functional smoke, extend to 2h for perf/metrics. Rollback triggers: >0.5% 5xx on canary OR p50 latency +30ms vs baseline OR any KMS auth failures.

Samir R.: I can own smoke scripts. Adding quick curl + healthcheck + KMS auth check. Example commands:```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference.redwood.local/health || echo HEALTH_FAIL
curl -sS -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://inference.redwood.local/predict | jq .status
# KMS test (uses service account key)
python tools/kms_test.py --key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/abcd --region us-west-2```
I'll push smoke scripts to infra/playbooks/smoke/kubeclient-1.4.3.sh and trigger.

Nina G.: I'll watch audit logs for RBAC+KMS interactions. Look for:
- audit.event: "kubeclient.exec" with user/service-account changes
- cloudtrail: kms:Decrypt Denied or AccessDenied entries
I can hook alerts to #eng-security if any deny spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for svc-inference-canary -> version kube-client@1.4.3 (10% traffic). Link: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/1858001234

AJ: Please add a short perf job: 2m synthetic load at normal concurrency to check p50/p95. Samir, can you run locust-lite for that?

Samir R.: On it. Quick perf steps:```bash
# lightweight synthetic load
locust -f perf/locustfiles/inference_small.py --headless -u 50 -r 10 -t 120s --host https://inference.redwood.local
# collect Prometheus metrics: request_duration_seconds p50,p95,errors
```
I'll post results in 45m.

Maya S.: Also enable extra KMS debug for canary pods for 2h (env var KMS_DEBUG=1). Ops, please confirm logging retention and redaction rules still applied.

ops-bot: KMS_DEBUG = 1 applied to svc-inference-canary pods. Logging routed to secure-audit-log, retention 90d, access restricted.

Nina G.: Quick note: we've seen a false-positive spike on a previous rollout where transient 403s from KMS caused retries and small p95 bump. If you see transient 403s, annotate channel and we'll verify it's not RBAC drift.

Samir R. (45m later): Perf run complete. Baseline p50: 48ms, canary p50: 57ms (+9ms). p95 baseline: 120ms, canary p95: 132ms (+12ms). Error rate: 0.08% (within threshold). No KMS AccessDenied events. Uploading graphs: https://metrics.redwood/runs/1858001234-perf

AJ: +1 on numbers. p50 +9ms is acceptable for now. No rollback. Recommend promote after 2h if numbers hold.

Nina G.: Audit tail shows normal RBAC events, no unexplained rolebindings created. Cloudtrail: no DecryptDenied spikes. All good from audit/KMS side.

Maya S.: Thanks team. We'll keep canary at 10% for another 75m then promote to 50% if stable. I'll open a short post-mortem checklist for the rollout with the steps we ran. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Canary extended for +75m. Will auto-promote to 50% at 1858006000 unless rollback triggers fire.

Maya S. (final): Leaving this thread open for any late issues. If anything pops up, tag me and @AJ.
